summary.name: NetFluss
summary.one_liner: NetFluss is a minimal, open-source macOS menu bar app that shows real-time upload and download speeds, identifies top bandwidth-using apps, and manages DNS switching and Wi-Fi details.
use_cases: Watch upload and download speeds in the macOS menu bar
Find which apps use the most bandwidth
Switch DNS providers quickly from the menu bar
Check Wi-Fi band, security and signal quality
Monitor total bandwidth of a Fritz!Box, Unifi or OpenWRT network
Connect to a VPN from the menu bar
summary.what_it_does: NetFluss displays configurable real-time upload and download rates in the macOS menu bar, covering all network interfaces including Wi-Fi and wired connections. It lists the top five bandwidth-using apps with filter options. A DNS switcher offers presets such as Cloudflare and Quad9 plus custom entries, with optional Touch ID confirmation. A Wi-Fi manager shows details on nearby networks (band, standard, WPA3, RSSI, SNR), lets users tag and limit networks, and an integrated VPN client supports OpenVPN, WireGuard and IKEv2/IPsec/L2TP according to the release notes.
notable: Open-source Swift build, lightweight menu bar app
One-click DNS provider switching with Touch ID confirmation
Monitoring for Fritz!Box, Unifi and OpenWRT routers
Integrated VPN client supporting OpenVPN, WireGuard and IKEv2/IPsec/L2TP
caveats: Page does not state pricing details beyond the listing's 'Freeware' label
